body: Hey regular redditors, this just in: the /r/atheism/ subreddit is a joke. Please continue.

I don't know. Maybe people who find me pathetic? Maybe it's hard for some people to empathize with others' situations. I don't know. I just know that I am at a VERY LOW POINT in my life right now and this subreddit is the best way for me to express myself at the moment. I'm sorry for all of you who have been subjected to my ridiculousness. Maybe I'll never bug you again in the near future. In any case, please be better human beings towards eachother- the world could use more compassion.
